_about: Validator fixture, not game data: a copy of the real Rival file, in the D1a shape.

sources._note: a building his blow, send, beam or body brings down, per unit of its mass (a house 1, a low tower 5, a tall tower 15: power.json absorb), times the arena norm (collateral.json massRef over the structure mass at the start) (bystanders.md section 3)

his power from the world: per unit of mass he levels, the same norm. Game Design's first value was 0.22; 0.07 puts a match's power from the world within 20% of what the old 0.09 a person gave (2.5 against 2.6 on the hand-made arena, 5.9 against 5.1 on planet 7, the mean of 16 and 6 AI matches, docs/world/runs/)
a crater his send or beam digs, at least minBh body heights across (powering up on the ground does not count)
terror: a lived-in building his blow empties (its first damage), by its size (a house, a low tower, a tall tower), times the arena norm; the lived-in flag is the building, never who is inside
combat trauma: a region of the opposing fighter broken (not normalised)
combat trauma: the opposing fighter reaches the brink (each time; not normalised)

effects._note: +perPoint x menace to the beam score
